package main

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "io"
 "os"

 "ponder.local/ponder-go/config"
)

func main(){
 data,err:=io.ReadAll(os.Stdin);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 cfg,err:=config.ParseSourceConfiguration(data);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 built,err:=config.BuildSourceConfig(cfg,config.SourceBuildOptions{});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 indexing,err:=config.BuildSourceIndexing(context.Background(),cfg,built,[]config.SourceIndexingFunction{{Name:"a:block",Fn:func(){}}});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 callbacks:=indexing.EventCallbacks()
 narrowed:=callbacks[0][0].Filter.(config.SourceBlockFilter)
 interval:=callbacks[0][0].Filter.Interval
 if interval!=1 || narrowed.Value()["fromBlock"]!=float64(16370000) || narrowed.Value()["toBlock"]!=float64(16370020){panic("original block filter values changed")}
 output,_:=json.Marshal(map[string]any{"interval":interval,"filter":narrowed.Value(),"callback":callbacks[0][0].Name})
 fmt.Println(string(output))
}
